core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; OTC Healthcare; Personal Care; Cosmetics; Digital Health Services
specialty_focus: Droga Raia is a Brazilian retail pharmacy chain operating drugstores and offering prescription medicines, over-the-counter drugs, personal care items, and cosmetics. It focuses on expanding digital and omnichannel services, including online ordering and delivery, to complement its physical stores. It is part of RD Saúde, one of Brazil's largest pharmacy retail groups, and does not specifically specialize in wearable medical devices.
